[SWS_DM_00064] Definition of
DTC
groups
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04117, RS_Diag_04115
⌈
The existence of a
DiagnosticTroubleCodeGroup
shall define the existence of
the
DTC group
with the DTC identifier
DiagnosticTroubleCodeGroup.group-
Number
⌋
Note: Refers to [TPS_DEXT_03014] in [4].
